request.text_prompt: Create original cold cinematic science-fiction game audio, approximately 1 seconds. Brief spacecraft console interaction, tactile hardware and a small electronic response. Two firm mechanical key presses with a tiny dry confirmation chirp. One self-contained event or specified short sequence; clear attack, natural decay, quiet clean tail; no abrupt truncation or long dead air. No vocals, singing, humming, speech, narration, lyrics or spoken prompt. No clipping, harsh distortion or unrelated scene sounds. No music, melody or soundtrack.
